description: Enhanced word-list dictionary membership cases: empty dictionary (every query unknown), empty query list (no output), duplicate-cased entries, and non-ASCII entries demonstrating that case folding is ASCII-only (an accented entry does not match its de-accented or uppercased non-ASCII query). For each query word the result is the word, a space, and either true or false, one per line, in the order given. The request is {"op":"check","dict":[entries...],"words":[queries...]}.

cases.expected_output:
a true
A true
aa false
